assumptions.assumption: A large track is one with Bytes at or above the cutoff (>= 10323804), since 'taking X as the cutoff' is read as inclusive.
The average bytes per millisecond is the average of the per-track ratios (Bytes/Milliseconds), not total bytes divided by total milliseconds.
Tracks with NULL Bytes are excluded from both averages, since they cannot be classified as large.

alternatives.interpretation: Large means strictly greater than the cutoff (Bytes > 10323804).
